title: The Last Sunrise
plot_overview: A college student with a chronic illness travels to Mallorca with her mother for the summer. As she falls for a local and explores the island, she tries to make the most of the moment while her health and complicated family matters threaten to reshape their summer.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like summer romances, scenic island settings, and stories about living in the moment; Not for you if predictable plots and sentimental drama are dealbreakers.
review_summary: Pros: attractive island setting; vulnerable lead performance; romance novel appeal | Cons: predictable story; familiar movie template; uneven performances
